sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their impressive form. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, extending a run of five wins in their last six outings. They face bottom-placed Alsager Town, who have managed just one win all season and arrive on the back of five consecutive defeats, making this a strong opportunity for the leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could keep them close to the summit after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth's visit to Eccleshall pits two high-flying sides in the top five against each other, with Bridgnorth looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, also in the top four, host struggling Wednesfield Community, who have won just one of their last six. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table affair featuring two teams with solid recent form. Shawbury United face a tough test at home to Barnton, with Shawbury having lost their last four matches while Barnton have picked up a win in their most recent outing. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a clash between sides occupying the lower-middle reaches of the table. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a fixture between struggling sides, while Brereton Social host Widnes Town—bottom of the league with just two points from seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's poorest-performing sides.
